sentences.ko: 응, 이 망할 벽 때문에 옆집 소리가 다 들려.
sentences.text: Yeah, you can hear everything through these stupid walls.

alts.text: These walls are so thin, you hear everything.
Indeed, one can hear everything through these walls.

sentences.note: 벽이 얇아 옆집 소리가 다 들린다고 투덜댈 때 **hear everything through** 뒤에 the walls 를 붙여 씁니다. 벽이 얇다는 말은 **so thin** 으로 짧게 할 수 있어요.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 10 | Friends

sentences.ko: 있잖아, 말 바르게 하는 게 뭐 어때서.
sentences.text: YOU KNOW, THERE'S NOTHING WRONG WITH speaking correctly.

alts.text: Talking properly's totally fine, you know.
There is nothing wrong with speaking properly.

sentences.note: 누가 내 방식을 놀릴 때 "그게 뭐 어때서"라고 받아치는 말이 **nothing wrong with** 입니다. 뒤에 -ing 를 붙여 무엇이든 넣을 수 있어요.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 1 | Friends

sentences.text: You didn't know how I was going to react.

alts.text: Didn't know how I'd take it, huh?
It was not clear to you how I was going to react.

sentences.note: 상대가 말을 미루거나 숨긴 이유를 짚어 줄 때 **how I was going to react** 를 씁니다. 캐주얼하게는 **how I'd take it** 이라고도 해요.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 5 | Friends

sentences.ko: 그리스에서 그렇게 재밌게 놀다 왔다니 정말 잘됐다.
sentences.text: It's so good that you had such a good time in Greece.

alts.text: Glad you had a blast in Greece!
I am very pleased to hear that you enjoyed your time in Greece so much.

sentences.note: 여행 다녀온 사람에게 "재밌게 놀다 왔다니 잘됐다"고 할 때 **had such a good time** 이 딱 맞습니다. 더 신나게 말하려면 **had a blast** 를 써요.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 5 | Friends

sentences.ko: 아니, 내가 지금 너한테 그런 신호를 보내고 있다는 거야?
sentences.text: I mean, am I sending you these signals right now?

alts.text: Wait, am I giving off signals right now?
Is it your impression that I am sending you signals at this moment?

sentences.note: 상대가 내 행동을 호감 표시로 오해했을 때 되묻는 말입니다. **sending you these signals** 는 "그런 티를 낸다"는 뜻이고, **giving off signals** 도 같은 자리에서 써요.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 8 | Friends

sentences.ko: 그냥 그 여자랑 한번 사귀어 보지 그래?
sentences.text: Why don't you just go out with her?

alts.text: Just ask her out already.
Perhaps you should simply ask her on a date.

sentences.note: **Why don't you just**는 망설이는 친구한테 "그냥 ~하지 그래?" 하고 등 떠밀 때 씁니다. **go out with**는 누구와 데이트하거나 사귄다는 뜻으로 아주 흔하게 씁니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 5 | Friends

sentences.ko: 의사가 그 말을 믿어 줄 줄은 몰랐어.
sentences.text: I didn't think the doctor was going to buy that.

alts.text: Never thought the doc would fall for it.
I did not expect the doctor to believe that explanation.

sentences.note: **buy that**은 물건을 사는 게 아니라 핑계나 둘러댄 말을 "믿어 준다"는 뜻입니다. 둘러댄 게 통했을 때나 안 통할 것 같을 때 "He'll never buy that"처럼 씁니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 그 돈 벌려고 테이블 닦고 우유 데우고 다 했는데, 진짜 하나도 안 아깝더라... 아니, 완전 헛고생이었어.
sentences.text: I wiped tables for it, I steamed milk for it, and it was totally not worth it.

alts.text: All those tables and all that milk, and for what? Total waste.
After all the tables I wiped and the milk I steamed, it was simply not worth the effort.

sentences.note: **totally not worth it**은 고생한 것에 비해 얻은 게 없을 때 "완전 헛고생이었다"는 말투입니다. 같은 말(**for it**)을 되풀이해서 얼마나 고생했는지 강조하는 것도 말에서 자주 씁니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 1 | Friends

sentences.ko: 지난번에 거기랑 인터뷰했을 때 어떻게 됐는지 기억 안 나?
sentences.text: Remember what happened the last time I did an interview for them?

alts.text: You forget how that last interview went?
Do you recall what happened when I last gave them an interview?

sentences.note: **Remember what happened the last time**는 "지난번에 어떻게 됐는지 기억 안 나?" 하고 같은 일을 또 하기 싫다고 넌지시 말할 때 씁니다. 뒤에 I did, you tried 같은 말만 바꿔 넣으면 됩니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 8 | Friends

sentences.ko: 근데 이건 맞고 틀리고가 없는 문제잖아.
sentences.text: But there there is no right or wrong here.

alts.text: Look, nobody's right or wrong on this one.
However, in this case, neither answer is correct or incorrect.

sentences.note: **no right or wrong**은 의견이 갈릴 때 "정답이 있는 문제가 아니다"라고 분위기를 누그러뜨리는 말입니다. 끝에 붙은 **here**는 "이 문제에서는" 정도의 뜻입니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 3 | Friends
